content:
DIF Nuevo Laredo has wrapped up its free mammogram campaign with more than 730 breast cancer screenings provided at no cost to women across the city.

The campaign, which began in September as part of the city's breast cancer awareness efforts, aimed to bring early detection services to women, especially those in vulnerable situations, according to CML Noticias.

Claudette Canturosas Villarreal, president of DIF Nuevo Laredo, said early detection is one of the most important tools in the fight against breast cancer, and stressed the importance of women getting regular checkups.

The free campaign was aimed mainly at women between the ages of 40 and 65, with a medical referral needed for women outside that age range.

Although the special free campaign has ended, mammograms will remain available year-round at the DIF Radiology Center, located inside the Centro de Rehabilitación Integral (CRI) at Jaumave #6970 in colonia La Fe, for a 300-peso recovery fee, so cost does not keep women from getting screened.

Women interested in scheduling an appointment can get information and book through WhatsApp at 867 229 3885.

Sources: CML Noticias and El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo, reporting on the DIF Nuevo Laredo mammogram campaign on November 4, 2026.

title: DIF Nuevo Laredo wraps free mammogram campaign with more than 730 screenings
